guard: a false-to-true claude/channel activation re-fires the remembered focus mention before considering buffered wake state
why: The focus mention is ack-dropped at ingest, so pendingWake() is zero and no inbox or JetStream redelivery can satisfy the activation assertion.

The mutation deletes the unique mention-first reconcile line only. The buffered-wake fallback remains, which proves the focus assertion depends on the exact production path rather than merely on activation doing some work.

mutations.name: activation skips the remembered focus mention and falls through to buffered wake state
mutations.find:
if (pendingMentionWake) nudge(pendingMentionWake.item, pendingMentionWake.hint, true);
        else if (agent.pendingWake() > 0) nudge();
mutations.expectRed: activation re-fires the remembered focus mention
mutations.cell: activation re-fires the remembered focus mention
mutations.note: The buffered fallback cannot recover this message: focus ingest already acknowledged and removed its body, so the activation notice remains absent.
